notes: «فقال أسيد بن حضير» is a remark inside Aisha's own account, part of the matn; it is not a route. Aisha is the last link.
«حدثه عن أبيه»: the father of عبد الرحمن is not named in the text, so relation.
«أن عبد الرحمن بن القاسم حدثه» is a transmission verb (rule 5), which makes عبد الرحمن a link.
